<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# World model update:
# - Trolley tip T in {22,28,34,40,46} (steps of 6). RIGHT extends, LEFT retracts.
# - Hooked blocks occupy slots relative to T. New hook happens at tip when T reaches a block's right edge+1.
# - Extending: tip block tries to advance; if blocked it stays (shifts back a slot); new block hooks at tip.
# - Retract: all hooked blocks move with T.
# - Riding blocks (top = beam_top-1) move with beam vertically; beam pushes blocks below.
# Current: T=40, beam 32-33, blue 36-39(tip,rows31-34), red 30-33(rows31-34), green 42-45(rows37-40, NOT hooked).
# Goal hypothesis: hook all 3 (order red,green,blue per legend). Currently chain red,blue; green not hooked.
# Plan: bring beam to green's row (2 DOWN -> beam 38-39, blue/red ride to rows37-40), then RIGHT to hook green.
action(['DOWN','DOWN'])
f=current_frame
def blk(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and 10<n['boundary'][0][0]<55 and n['pixels']>=12:
            d[n['color']]=(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))
    return d
a=f.ascii.split('\n')
ws=[c for c,ch in enumerate(a[38]) if ch in 'wg'] if len(a)>38 else []
print('after 2 DOWN: beam row38 max', max(ws) if ws else None, 'blocks', blk(f))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# World model update:
# - Trolley tip T in {22,28,34,40,46} (steps of 6). RIGHT extends, LEFT retracts.
# - Hooked blocks occupy slots relative to T. New hook happens at tip when T reaches a block's right edge+1.
# - Extending: tip block tries to advance; if blocked it stays (shifts back a slot); new block hooks at tip.
# - Retract: all hooked blocks move with T.
# - Riding blocks (top = beam_top-1) move with beam vertically; beam pushes blocks below.
# Current: T=40, beam 32-33, blue 36-39(tip,rows31-34), red 30-33(rows31-34), green 42-45(rows37-40, NOT hooked).
# Goal hypothesis: hook all 3 (order red,green,blue per legend). Currently chain red,blue; green not hooked.
# Plan: bring beam to green's row (2 DOWN -> beam 38-39, blue/red ride to rows37-40), then RIGHT to hook green.
action(['DOWN','DOWN'])
f=current_frame
def blk(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and 10<n['boundary'][0][0]<55 and n['pixels']>=12:
            d[n['color']]=(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))
    return d
a=f.ascii.split('\n')
ws=[c for c,ch in enumerate(a[38]) if ch in 'wg'] if len(a)>38 else []
print('after 2 DOWN: beam row38 max', max(ws) if ws else None, 'blocks', blk(f))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
